items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, for a long time. St. Cyr was with that band too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well he was the one that learned Jimmy Noon sax, or clarinet. Clarinet? Yeah. Well then Jimmy Noon played with Freddie Wilde, he played with Manuel, and he played with Joe Oliver. Then he left and he went to Chicago, and he played with Cooks, I think it was Cook.
Yeah, for a long time. St. Cyr was with that band too.
Yeah, he played with Cook. Then after a while he organized a band of his own, Guy Kelly. Used to play with Celestine, I played with him, you know. And the last time I heard about him he died in L.A.
